background.value: plain white, light grey, or cream

head_height.value: face takes up 70-80% of the frame

file_spec.value: JPEG format, minimum 715 x 951 pixels, maximum 9MB, colour, no compression artifacts

clothing_restriction.value: uniforms (civil or military) and insignia-bearing clothing not permitted

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, no smiling

glasses_policy.value: transparent glasses permitted if frames do not cover eyes and no glare on lenses; sunglasses not permitted

face_visibility.value: face fully visible; hair cannot cover eyes; full head to mid-torso visible

headwear_policy.value: allowed for religious or medical reasons only; no other head accessories permitted

size.evidence: The official DFA passport photo guidelines page at dfa.ie/passports/photo-guidelines/ (fetched directly) confirms printed photos must have a minimum of 35mm x 45mm and maximum of 38mm x 50mm. The ireland.ie mirror of the same guidelines (ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/photo-guidelines/) confirms the same dimensions. Multiple independent sources (passlens.com, passport-photo.online, 123passportphoto.com) corroborate this range.
